title: URL userinfo with a username and no colon
summary: A synthetic URL with a user name before the at-sign and no colon, the position some services use for a token.
rationale: RFC 3986 speaks only of data after the first colon. Whether a colon-less userinfo value is a public user name or a token used in the user position depends on the service and the value; no source read settles it for the generic case.

expectation.rationale: Unresolved. The RFC statement covers data after the first colon only; a colon-less userinfo is not addressed. Candidate outcomes: not flagged as a user name, or flagged when the value is a recognised credential in the user position. A maintainer decision (project-policy with a non-author reviewer), or a provider statement per family, would settle it. No fixture is authored.

sources.supports: Statement limited to data after the first colon.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed.
